The '''Jedi testing screen''' was a portable [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] used by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to test potential candidates for training.<ref name="SWCVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The testing screen was devoid of any buttons or controls, and was instead activated by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="SWCVD" /> The device was programmed to display a series of unconnected [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] images on the screen, held out of view of the student, who would then attempt to [[Force sense/Legends|divine]] the object shown using the Force. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was notably tested by [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] using a testing screen in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Description==
[[File:JediTestingScreen-EpIVD.png|thumb|left|250px|A deactivated Jedi test screen.]]
The testing screen was a small [[Limb/Legends|handheld]]<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref> multi-function [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]]<ref name="SWCVD" /> utilized by the [[Jedi Order]] to test an inductee's [[Force sense/Legends|divination]] abilities, a rudimentary identifiable example of [[The Force/Legends|Force]] use<ref name="Episode 1" /> or to practice a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight's]] skill. It included a removable memory cell in which standard tests were stored; the cell was stored in the device's handgrip and could be removed to access the test results. A tension band was mounted on the top of the device, directly above the screen which was powered by a single [[Power cell/Legends|power cell]] connected to the rear of the device.<ref name="SWCVD" />

The sequence of images displayed on the viewscreen were unconnected and followed each other with extreme speed, allowing only a Force-attuned individual to perceive them. The tester watched the screen and directed the flow of the images with the Force, as the device lacked any buttons or controls,<ref name="SWCVD" /> allowing only capable [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] to use them.<ref name="Episode 1" /> A series of infographics including the test series indicator and the ability testing sequence appeared on the top and bottom of the screen along with the test images to assist the tester with the procedure.<ref name="SWCVD" />

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], after Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] rescued former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] from his master [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he brought [[Gender/Legends|him]] before the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where several Masters, including [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] tested his abilities using a testing screen. Although the child was successful in identifying images including [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder]], the Council elected not to take him in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] due to his old age.<ref name="Episode 1" />
